name: Stripe MCP Server
what: Stripe's MCP server that lets AI agents work with the Stripe API (customers, products, prices, invoices, subscriptions and more) and search Stripe's docs and support articles.
who: Builders adding payments to an app, or managing customers and products with an agent.

setup.text: Recommended: install the Stripe CLI and run agent setup. It detects your agents and configures the MCP server plus Stripe's skills.
Manual: add the remote server https://mcp.stripe.com. Claude Code (then /mcp to sign in with OAuth):
setup.code: claude mcp add --transport http stripe https://mcp.stripe.com/

setup.text: For clients without OAuth, use an agent API key as a Bearer token. From Dec 2026, plain secret/restricted keys stop working. Try it in a sandbox first; refunds and payouts require human confirmation.

prompts: Create a sandbox product 'Pro Plan' with a $9/month price.
How do I handle a failed subscription payment webhook?
List my most recent customers in the sandbox.
